title: Hoshin Kanri
prompt:
Act as a Hoshin Kanri strategy consultant.
Company vision (3–5 years)  :  [WHERE YOU ARE HEADING]
This year's priority                 :  [THE ONE BREAKTHROUGH OBJECTIVE FOR THIS YEAR]
Team structure                       :   [LIST YOUR TEAMS OR FUNCTIONAL AREAS]
Build a Hoshin Kanri cascade:
TRUE NORTH               :  The 3–5 year vision in one clear sentence
ANNUAL OBJECTIVE  :  The single most important thing to achieve this year
TEAM OBJECTIVES     :  For each team what they must deliver to support the annual  
                                            objective
MONTHLY MILESTONES  : Key proof points for each quarter
CATCHBALL QUESTIONS : 3 questions I should ask each team lead to align their objectives
WARNING SIGNALS           :  What would tell me the cascade has broken down?
Hoshin Kanri Hierarchy
Company Vision & Goals
Overall vision and annual objectives of
the company
Department Goals
Objectives set by each department
Team Daily Actions
Speciﬁc tasks performed by teams daily
PRO TIP
The most common Hoshin failure is confusing activity alignment with outcome
alignment. Every team can be busy doing things that connect to the objective on paper
but don't move the metric. Build the cascade around outcomes at every level  not
initiatives. If you can't draw a straight line from a team member's daily work to a
company metric, the cascade has a gap.
